title: Ordinary direct image under completed coefficient realizations
statement: For prime l, any scheme morphism f:X to S and any two CompletedRealizations eX,eS of [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-reference], there exists a CompletedOrdinarySquare l f eX eS of [lem-diagonal-completed-push-square]. Its natural isomorphism from completed direct image followed by eS to eX followed by condensed direct image is normalized by the given underlying-sheaf comparisons. No derived model, line class or supported source is asserted.

source.place: paragraph (1); initial coefficient and supported-source identification, expanded in lem-diagonal-completed-frame proof

proof.text: Define the underlying isomorphism by eS.underlying at the completed direct image, followed by direct image of the inverse of eX.underlying. For a local condensed coefficient a, pull it back through the normalized regular-module isomorphism bS. Apply the single-site action identity at S and X. The coefficient-only compatibility identifies the two scalar sections, and the explicit completed direct-image action is the action of a times one on the source module. The sectionwise tensor comparison is jointly detecting, so these identities prove that the underlying isomorphism is linear.

Package the underlying isomorphisms as internal module isomorphisms. Naturality follows by faithfulness of forgetting and the naturality of the two underlying comparisons. The normalization follows by functoriality and cancellation of eX.underlying.inv against eX.underlying.hom.

proof_origin.note: Explicit construction and proof from two strictly smaller statements: a one-site action identity and a coefficient-only direct-image identity. This is a decomposition, not net hole closure.

    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    (eX : CompletedRealization l X) (eS : CompletedRealization l S) :
    Nonempty (CompletedOrdinarySquare l f eX eS)
